help.title: Controls
hud.hint: Move: WASD or arrows. Attack: click a monster or hold Space and the hero walks up and keeps striking until you take the movement keys; a click on the ground strikes toward the cursor. A warrior swings a sword; an archer and a mage shoot. Skills: Q, E, R (learn them from the trainer in the village). Potions: 1 and 2. Weapon charges on or off: F. T: talk to the person next to you, or enter a glowing doorway. Right mouse button: walk to a spot. I: bag. Walk over loot to pick it up. Point at a monster to see its name, level and health. In the village the hunter tells what each monster drops, and the blacksmith tempers and crafts equipment. The world is open: leave the village through the east gate and follow the road.
skillInfo.heavyBlow: A narrow, far-reaching strike toward the cursor that deals more than double damage.
skillInfo.sweep: A strike that hits every monster around you.
skillInfo.secondWind: Restores about a third of your health at once.
skillInfo.powerShot: A heavy arrow toward the cursor that passes through every monster in its way.
skillInfo.volley: Five arrows at once, in a fan.
skillInfo.swiftness: For a few seconds you walk much faster.
skillInfo.fireBolt: A bolt of fire toward the cursor that bursts and burns everything near its target.
skillInfo.frostNova: A ring of frost that hits every monster around you and slows it.
skillInfo.mend: Restores about a third of your health at once.
